blocks.text: Streaming platform Prime Video announced its plan to implement an increase on its monthly subscription rate to P249, citing various production investments and content programming as reason for the hike. The rate adjustment, which is effective October 21, was announced during a virtual meeting with select media organizations, including INQUIRER Entertainment. Under the new scheme, the annual subscription fee is calculated at P1669 per year, which is equivalent to approximately P139 monthly, still relatively competitive with the rates of other on-demand streaming services.
